The raw 3 in 3ORT is repaired to D by one observed-coordinate substitution; the printed dash is filled for M in MELDEN.

geometry.source_layer_basis: Twenty visibly handwritten slots occur between typed indices 74 and 75. Under the primary D reading, they duplicate the next four typed groups. The 238 typed slots independently match the printed length.

alternative_composite_transmission_model.model: Treat all 258 slots, including the handwriting, as transmitted material before excluding the annotation positions.
alternative_composite_transmission_model.status: Separate conditional interpretation; not a zero-cost transmission deletion.

handwritten_glyph_sensitivity.reason: The handwritten third rounded glyph of DDDDF can be read as D or O. The following typed DDDDF supports a duplicate-annotation interpretation but does not independently resolve this glyph.

limits: Typed and handwritten source layers are preserved separately. The accepted typed-only frame does not depend on the D/O annotation ambiguity; the composite-transmission interpretation carries an explicit 20-slot exclusion cost.
p74 C1 is one explicit fill candidate for 30 printed dash slots, not a proof of its full historical wording.
Names, reference numerals, doubled letters and shorthand remain literal except for individually priced changes.
Only the supplied published October 28–31 key is used; no key cell or transposition rank is fitted here.
The body and key can establish a readable source edition without establishing the historical identity of a named firm or person.
